title: Volition control-plane workflows
warnings: Dry-runs only simulate effects. Production inbox triage calls one private provider-neutral classifier capability.
The registry contains no credentials, message bodies, document contents, or production run imports.
Mastra owns workflow state, retries, schedules and run history. Hermes executes agent stages and does not own business schedules.

flows.name: Inbox triage
flows.description: Classify an inbound message and prepare a bounded routing proposal.

steps.title: Prepare inbox context
steps.description: Validate the event envelope, project capability grant and stable effect identifiers.

steps.title: Classify through capability
steps.description: Call the private provider-neutral inbox-triage.v1 capability with bounded retries; the Plan worker applies the result.

currentLimits: Gmail credentials and provider/model configuration remain in the host adapter; Mastra never sends mail or writes Plan issues.

flows.name: Project agent team
flows.description: Coordinate project work through Hermes specialists, require coordinator review and synchronize evidence to the matching Plan task.

reliability.idempotency: One deterministic key per event, phase and assignment.
reliability.leases: Hermes returns bounded leases with current heartbeat timestamps.
reliability.retries: Mastra retries durable steps and the private adapter applies bounded exponential backoff with the same idempotency key.
reliability.checkpoints: Each Mastra step persists coordinator, specialist and review results before the next phase.
reliability.history: Safe stage summaries, attempts and timestamps are stored in the Mastra run output.

steps.title: Validate team
steps.description: Validate project scope, task identity, team membership and execution policy.

steps.title: Create delegations
steps.description: Route the task to one specialist when the team has one or the task labels match the capabilities of exactly one; otherwise ask the Hermes coordinator for bounded assignments with dependencies.

steps.title: Execute specialist work
steps.description: Run specialist assignments in dependency order, independent ones in parallel, through the private Hermes bridge with leases, run limits and stable idempotency keys.

steps.title: Review evidence
steps.description: Have the coordinator evaluate evidence against the task acceptance criteria when the project requires a review.

steps.title: Synchronize Plan
steps.description: Write the summary and evidence to the exact project task exactly once and set Review, or Done when the project autonomy is done and the review accepted the work.

currentLimits: The private Hermes team bridge must implement the documented Unix-socket contract before production runs are enabled. Dry-runs make no Hermes or Plan call.

flows.name: Agent routine
flows.description: Create or reopen a Plan task on a schedule and delegate it to a project agent, one open task at a time.

steps.title: Prepare the fire
steps.description: Take the event id of the fire from its run id, list the run in its project and mark a fire that started more than ten minutes late as missed.

steps.title: Create or reopen the task
steps.description: Ask Plan through the private bridge to create the task, or reopen the named one, and delegate it to the agent. Plan changes nothing while the task of the routine is still open.

currentLimits: Routines are created and changed on the Schedules page of a Plan project. A fire that starts more than ten minutes after its time is skipped.
